payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether Outfall 001 monitoring is required continuously every month or only when authorized event-type discharges occur. The packet's part_i excerpt names the authorized discharge categories (storm runoff, once-through cooling, cleaning water, Artesian well water) but does not state monitoring frequency, event-trigger conditions, or an applicability rule linking those discharge types to monitoring obligations. Cover dates and the FY2025 window establish temporal scope only. The packet explicitly notes that NODI code legends are absent; without monitoring-requirement tables or NODI legends, neither burden for ACCEPT (conditional monitoring applies) nor REJECT (continuous monthly monitoring applies) is met. Uncertainty is left unresolved rather than closed by absence of monitoring-language in the selected spans.
